notes.title: 📰 Steam Next Fest Announcement – RAVENRIDGE
notes.content:
[h2]📰 [b]Steam Next Fest Announcement – RAVENRIDGE[/b][/h2][hr][/hr][p][b]🎮 RAVENRIDGE Demo Now Live – Enter the Experiment[/b][/p][p]We are excited to announce that the [b]demo for RAVENRIDGE[/b] is now live as part of [b]Steam Next Fest[/b]![/p][p]Step into the decaying ruins of an abandoned prison, unravel the experiments buried beneath, and face a system that was never shut down.
You play as [b]Ethan Ward[/b], a troubled private investigator drawn into a psychological spiral of surveillance, control, and forgotten memories.[/p][hr][/hr][p]🧠 [b]What to Expect:[/b][/p][list][*][p]An atmospheric, story-driven psychological horror[/p][/*][*][p]30–45 minutes of intense gameplay[/p][/*][*][p]No combat. Just you, your mind, and what’s left of it[/p][/*][*][p]Multiple floors, each more unstable than the last[/p][/*][*][p]Strange figures… always watching[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]💡 If you enjoy games like [i]SOMA[/i], [i]Signalis[/i], or [i]Observer[/i], this might be the next descent you’re looking for.[/p][hr][/hr][p]🔗 [b]Play the Demo Now:[/b]
[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3734540/RAVENRIDGE/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]🕯️ [i]The system is watching.[/i]
[i]The question is—are you the subject, or the observer?[/i][/p]
